name: Boss Hunter's Display Case
teaser: Adds a  new container called the "Boss Hunter's Display Case" sold by Ragman L2.  Store it all in a cardboard box!
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
This mod is made possible thanks to Jehree’s “Duc’s Custom Case Framework“ mod. All thanks go to him.

Do you enjoy collecting unique items from the bosses you defeat? Would you like to keep them safe and organized without taking up valuable space in your Item Case or Stash? If so, then this mod is the perfect solution for you.

Introducing the Boss Hunters Display Case

This sleek display case is perfect for showing off your hard-earned trophies from the most notorious bosses in Tarkov. With its tempered glass panels and reinforced metal frame, it’s the perfect way to showcase your collection. Definetally not a cardboard box

It has some limitations and can not hold these items, mostly because I just thought it was too silly. If you want them, let me know.

ASh-12 12.7x55 assault rifle
RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun
BlackHawk! Commando chest harness (Black)
Azimut SS “Khamelion” chest harness (Olive)
Santa’s Bag

It has a conflicting error with SVM’s Case Management Filter settings. You can either disable all filters in SVM or wait for me to update this mod with Jehree’s fix whenever he has the time for it.

If you run into problems or issues, I am only able to provide limited support. I did not make this mod, I simply added Item ID’s and changed the config.

To install:

Drop it into your SPT folder

BEFORE UNINSTALL

Delete the case from your stash/inventory.
